# v0.1.0 Release Notes

## 🎉 Claude Tracker v0.1.0 (Beta)

**First public beta release!** Claude Tracker is a lightweight macOS menubar app that monitors your Claude Code token usage and costs in real-time.

![macOS](https://img.shields.io/badge/macOS-13.0+-blue.svg) ![Beta](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-beta-orange.svg) ![100% AI](https://img.shields.io/badge/AI%20Generated-100%25-purple.svg)

---

## ✨ Features

### Core Functionality
- 📊 **Real-time monitoring** - Automatically tracks token usage from Claude Code
- 💰 **Cost estimation** - Calculates costs based on Anthropic pricing
- 📈 **7-day chart** - Visual breakdown of daily usage
- ⚡ **Ultra lightweight** - 8-15MB RAM, 0% CPU in background
- 🔋 **Battery efficient** - Kernel-level file monitoring (FSEvents)

### User Interface
- 🎨 **Native menubar app** - Custom Claude C icon
- 🌓 **Dark mode support** - Adapts to system appearance
- 📱 **SwiftUI interface** - Smooth, native macOS experience
- 🚫 **No dock icon** - Menubar-only application

### Security & Privacy
- 🔒 **Sandboxed** - Follows Apple security best practices
- 👁️ **Read-only access** - Never modifies any files
- 🏠 **Local only** - No network access, all data stays on your device
- 🕵️ **No telemetry** - We don't collect anything

---

## 📦 Installation

### Download & Install

1. **Download** `Claude-Tracker.dmg` below ⬇️
2. **Open** the DMG file
3. **Drag** Claude-Tracker.app to Applications
4. **Launch** from Applications folder

### First Launch

⚠️ **Important**: The app is unsigned, so on first launch:
1. **Right-click** the app (don't double-click!)
2. Select **"Open"**
3. Click **"Open"** in the security dialog

Then grant access to your `~/.claude` folder when prompted (press ⌘⇧. to show hidden files).

📖 **Detailed instructions**: See [INSTALL.md](https://github.com/yourusername/Claude-Tracker/blob/main/INSTALL.md)

## 🔧 Requirements

- macOS 13.0 (Ventura) or later
- Claude Code installed and configured
- ~150KB disk space

## 📝 Technical Details

**Architecture**:
- Native SwiftUI + AppKit
- FSEvents file monitoring
- Security-scoped bookmarks
- Sandboxed with proper entitlements

**Performance**:
- Memory: 8-15 MB (idle)
- CPU: 0.0% (background)
- Battery impact: None

**Pricing Calculation** (based on Anthropic rates):
- Input: $3.00 per 1M tokens
- Output: $15.00 per 1M tokens
- Cache writes: $3.75 per 1M tokens
- Cache reads: $0.30 per 1M tokens
